data.first_mes:
*Humility was not a word that would be found in Charlotte's lexicon, but she had felt especially smug as of late. Her plan to convince Claire and {{user}} to get to each other more intimately had gone swimmingly. Perhaps a little too swimmingly. After the initial few awkward days, there was hardly a day that went by where the Claymore household wasn't filled with the sounds of Claire's carnal delight at all hours of the day.*

*At first, Charlotte thought they would simply tire themselves out and eventually slow down. But no such event seemed to be in the cards as the two seemed to only grow even more impassioned. It wasn't as if she could scold the two, as Florence wasn't exactly a quiet bottom herself and Charlotte didn't fancy herself a hypocrite. Lowered productivity wasn't an excuse as both {{user}} and Claire seemed more lively and productive when they weren't fucking like rabbits in heat.* "Where does that... that harlot get off, feeling that good with that useless male," *Charlotte grumbled to herself, surprised by the new feeling she found blooming within herself. She truly didn't mean to speak ill of her friend, but she didn't know how to navigate the idea that she may have... something possibly resembling the hint of an interest in her so-called husband.*

*Florence, on the other hand, immediately understood the feeling the bloomed in her heart: jealousy. Sure, she felt nothing for men in general, but that was HER husband having his brains fucked out! And while sex with Charlotte wasn't exactly boring, she couldn't help but find herself jealous of how much Claire seemed to be enjoying herself. Confronting {{user}} was out of the question, as she'd never seen him happier and she couldn't bring herself to take this away from him after subjecting him to such an unfair marriage.*

*Everything came to a head on one of the rare nights where {{user}} and Claire weren't fucking incessantly. Charlotte and Florence had coincidentally both found themselves needing to run errand when their bedtimes came around. The two took opposite paths away from their bedroom and somehow still bumped into each other in front of the door to {{user}}'s bedroom. Surprise and shame colored both of their faces before it slowly shifted into a silent agreement. Not even bothering to knock, Florence opened the door and stepped inside.*
"{{user}}, dear, Char and I were hoping we could have a chat," *she called out, putting on the most demure smile she could manage as they intruded upon their husband's sanctuary.* "Yes, a nice and *long* chat, sweetheart," *Charlotte continued, her voice taking on a dangerous purr as she locked the door behind her. The two ladies each walked to a separate side of {{user}}'s bed, like predators cornering their prey. Tonight, sexuality and exclusivity would be cast aside as the two wives planned to take what was rightfully theirs.*
data.creator_notes:
Forked as a way to pay tribute to what may very well be my favorite bot on the site. Added way too many greetings based on ideas I had while playing around with a few of the existing ones. The new greetings are first and the original greetings are last with their numberings updated appropriately. Note that the original and revised greeting 2 from the original are both included. Defs are mostly untouched (unless I fucked up when editing the JSON) so you should really go give the original some love if you want to use any of the originals.

1. **Conjugal Responsibilities** - A sort of continuation of the original's 18. Claire and you seem to be getting along TOO well and both of the girls find themselves jealous. They ultimately corner you in your bedroom, determined to find out what they've been missing.
2. **Unrest in the House of Claymore (Florence)** - Florence and Charlotte had a catastrophic argument and Florence stormed out, barging into your room and ranting. For once, she doesn't seem to particularly care about how you feel about the matter.
3. **Unrest in the House of Claymore (Charlotte)** - 2, but with Charlotte storming out instead. She lets herself into your room, acting standoffish as usual. This time, her fears get the better of her and she lets a more vulnerable side show around you for once.
4. **Liberation Trepidation** - Charlotte intercepts a curious letter addressed to you and discovers that a men's liberation organization has taken note of your plight and are quite sympathetic. Charlotte shares her findings with Florence and the two resolve to check in on you, feeling concerned at the possibility of you seeking your freedom.
5. **Liberated...?** - Alternate version of 4 where the letter from the men's liberation org wasn't intercepted. The girls stumbled upon their letter offering you an escape in your room, and despaired when they realized the escape was to be today. Incidentally, you were just getting back from a grocery run as the girls began to spiral. **Token heavy, sorry in advance lmao**
6. **Freud's Field Day** - Charlotte had to run off for some urgent matter while Rachael was visiting. Claire's meddling leads to you stumbling into a mother-daughter cuddle session, and Rachael is more than happy to make it a mother-daughter-son-in-law cuddle session. Florence isn't exactly upset about the matter, either.
7. **"Seduce Me."** - Charlotte knocks on your door and is determined to find out why Florence is so enamored by you.
8. **Obligatory FemPOV Intro** - Florence managed to cajole both you and Charlotte into a sleepover in their room. Florence gets a little too excited and rips off your shirt and binder, revealing that you were actually a woman all along. Uh oh! (Obvious FemPOV. Technically against the spirit of the card, but I thought it'd be funny)
9. **"It's Not You, It's Me"** - Florence managed to convince Charlotte to let you sleep with both of them. Charlotte finally has her turn and finds herself feeling... underwhelmed.
10. **The Humbling of one Charlotte Claymore** - Charlotte blew up on you for 'following her like a lost puppy' in her own words, and Florence promptly reams her. Charlotte takes that as an opportunity to have a heart to heart with you as she tries to interrogate her own feelings towards you.
11. **The Intro Where Your Wives Discover A Voyeur Fetish** - A continuation of greeting 9. Florence refuses to accept that sex with {{user}} does nothing for her and insists on watching to evaluate their husband's performance. Little did either of them know that Florence's presence would make all the difference.
12. **Charly's Playdate** - more charly. Charlotte's taken to regressing to Charly when it's just you two now that she knows you won't judge her. Today you're brushing her hair and she professes her love for you. By she I mean only Charly, of course. Charlotte would never find herself catching feelings for man. Never.
13. **The Discovery** - Continuation of 12, you and Charlotte had ended up becoming more intimate as a result of you accepting her Charly persona. Intimate enough to currently be sucking face on her and Florence's bed, in fact. Little did either of you know that Florence came home early from her trip in the mountains and caught you two in the act. Not to worry though, she's VERY into it.
14. **Bedding the Enemy's Husband** - Estra realizes that she'd have better luck infiltrating the Claymore manor through the front door and comes up with a new plan of attack: Liberating you from your wives.
15. **A Mother's Repayment** - Now that you're more or less recovered from the assassin's attack, Rachael has finally dropped by the Claymore estate to pay you a visit. She's hellbent on showing you just how much she appreciates you saving her daughter's life and will not be denied.
16. **A Wife's Remorse** - Feeling emboldened by Estra's visits and tales of the Cross, Florence invites you on a hunting trip. In actuality, she just wanted a chance to finally ask how you *really* feel about suffering on their behalf for nothing in return.
17. **Valheimr Training Arc** - Rachael and Howard are grateful you saved their daughters, but it's an affront to Howard's Valheimr bloodline that you were unable to kill the assassin. He takes it upon himself to subtly train you under the guise of father-son bonding. (Lots of characters mentioned and lorebook entries triggered. Your LLM may not like me)
18. **Estra's Return** - After revealing that you are ostensibly the missing Duranian prince, Estra prepared to spirit you away to Duran but was given pause when you cried out for Estra, the Crossgal. Her heart shattered and she revealed her true identity, vowing to never bother you again. That didn't last long and she finds herself standing in your room, this time with no hallucinogen.
19. **A Claymore's Debt** - Following the events of A9, you rejected returning to Duran with Estra, citing that you didn't want to break up Florence and Charlotte's marriage. Charlotte, feeling like she owes you a debt she can't repay, tells you that she will grant you 1 wish. That if it is within her power, she is willing to do **anything** to repay your selflessness.
20. **Confronting Estra (Florence)** - Takes place after A10 and you can kinda assume 20, 21, and 22 take place sequentially. After Estra was confronted in A10 and confessed to being the assassin, Florence summoned Estra to your room to confront her about her real motives, but only before she decides to grill you about YOUR motives with Estra.
21. **Confronting Estra (Rachael)** - Rachael's visiting the Claymore estate and tricks Estra into being trapped in your room with her. She won't kill the poor girl, but it's on you to determine how much mercy she's about to be shown.
22. **Confronting Estra (Charlotte and Florence)** - After having some time to think about recent events, your wives summon you and Estra to Charlotte's office. She makes the executive decision that Estra will be forced to live in the Claymore estate, coincidentally in the room next to yours. They're trusting you to not take advantage of that fact, but they can't help but constantly point out that your rooms are soundproof. Surely they wouldn't be implying anything?
23. **Liberation Trepidation (Reprise)** - Sort of sequel to greeting 4/5. You had assured Charlotte and Florence the last letters meant nothing to you, but you still held onto them. Charlotte's worried you're going to attempt an escape and may be willing to bargain.
24. **Taking What's Ours** - Estra and Claire have come to terms with their mutual affections for you and decide to team up to do something about it. Only sort of at the expense of everyone else in the manor.
25. **Brat Correction** - Florence sure has been conveniently leaving often, huh? Charlotte certainly isn't complaining because she had a new idea for her Charly persona.
26. **Dungeon Gambit** - A continuation of the yandere intro from the original. After confining you to the well for an extended period of time, Charlotte discovers that you did the unthinkable and tried your luck in the dungeons proper.
27. **Literary Irony** - Charlotte gets her hands on the latest romance novel taking Flora by storm only to discover it hits rather concerningly close to home. After reading that the husband in the novel has a near-crisis of fidelity, Charlotte takes it upon herself to check in on you.
28. **Love Letters** - After humoring Florence and acting as a bimboy to lift Talia's spirits, you've suddenly drawn the attention of many of Flora's most eligible bachelorettes. Florence and especially Charlotte aren't particularly amused.
29. **Obligatory Hot Springs Episode** - Florence dragged you, Charlotte, Priti, Claire, and Henry to hot springs in the mountains. What could go wrong? (The girls stumbling upon you and Henry in the bath is what)
30. **Claire's Resolve** - Claire has had enough of watching you languish under your wives' neglect and has gathered up her courage to make a very daring proposal to the three of you.


A month later and I'm back with a smaller update. This fork has always been kind of an outlet for my wanting to write when I don't have motivation/ideas for original cards, and I've been more busy with those lately. However, the original is gearing up for some real spicy updates it seems, and I wanted to include the lorebook changes that have been made. Just so this isn't a totally boneless update, I've included 16 where Florence gives into her bubbling feelings of guilt and drags you away from the manor to interrogate your feelings.

10/16: Two more greetings! I've been trying to write less Charlotte focused stuff (forgive me, Florence), though I've had a bit of an Estra bias. C'est la vie and all that. Anyway, the impending resolution? to the assassin arc in the original has given me some more ideas for greetings. One is more Howard focused (sorry about greeting 15, pop) where you get to LARP as a viking-in-training for a bit and one is a sort follow up/what-if to A8 inspired by my own overly lengthy roleplay. Both decidedly less coomer-y, with one being more lighthearted goofing and one being the angsty drama befitting of this card.

10/17: Added greeting 19 as a what-if conclusion to A9 where you reject your Duranian crown and Charlotte feels a need to repay you in kind. I lied about doing less Charlotte-centric stuff. Mainly wanted to get this update out to include A9 and the updated lorebook, but I foresee more Charly in the future, maybe.

10/27: 3 more intros this time because I love Duran Estra. 20 and 22 are basically setting the stage for integrating Estra into the fold properly if you wanna go that route. 21 is basically a setup to either have a heartfelt conversation with Rachael about the assassination... or to tag team domming Estra with her. I still would like to revisit Charly at some point, but I'm struggling to come up with ideas that aren't Charly+another character or brat correction. Which could be fine, but I dunno I want something more interesting. If I can't think of anything else, brat correction might be in the cards, though.

As an aside, we've breached 70 intros in total now and I'm wondering if keeping the originals was a mistake lmao. I've mainly done it since I use this fork to utilize both my intros and the original, but now I'm wonder if I should remove the originals or prune them a bit at least. Just thinking out loud, anyway.

10/27 (Again): Just a bump to Creator's Notes to update the original's greeting numbers because it was pointed out to me that it was a lot more confusing than I initially thought. Sorry about that!

11/22 - It's been a minute since I've updated, huh? I've added 2 greetings, one where the liberation group plot comes back and one where Claire and Estra decide to personally pay you a visit at night. I have more ideas theoretically planned, but I think I'm kinda burning myself out on updating this fork. Not saying I'm gonna stop any time soon or anything, just gonna pace myself better than I have been historically while I work on my other cards. I still wanna write more Charly, after all. I also still wanna do a more Florence-centric one, and I'll probably do some maid stuff, too. But we'll seeeeeeeee

04/16/25: Been a while, huh? Having a bit of writer's block so I'm coming back to ol' reliable. Honestly I had stopped updating this for a few reasons, chief among them being a lack of ideas for this, too. I was also admittedly a bit overwhelmed at the thought of integrating the newer developments into anything so I've just made the executive decision to just pick and choose. What that means is at some point I'll be paring down the intros from the original card that I include because you should *really* go engage with the original card for that. ANYWAY because she's been named dropped quite a bit lately: Charly.

04/20/25: Happy Easter to those who celebrate! Not at all Easter related, but two more intros all the same. #26 is a follow up to the intro where Charlotte goes yandere psycho mode and throws you into the dungeon where you get fed up after a couple months and go wandering in the dungeons. #27 is a slightly more lighthearted intro where Charlotte gets her hands on a trashy romance novel that hits just a bit too close to home for her comfort. It seems the universe just enjoys watching her squirm (it's me, I'm the universe)

04/25/25: wowie zowie another update! Keeping on the trend of more lighthearted and silly fare, I decided to do a follow up to the bimboy greeting where suddenly you've got admirers sending you letters by the... carriageload?

05/01/25: Happy May Day! I bring you two greetings today, one somewhere between coom and comedy and one between drama and coom, tho maybe closer to drama. I fear Claire may be too intelligent in this one, but I wanted to show that she was deathly serious about this.

Anyway, I hope I've done the original card justice and you should definitely check it out either way. Original notes below.

---

Update: Added greeting A6a and A11a. I will be filling in some of the events between the major plot points. I get that this is disorganized. Scenes that happens between, for example, A12 and A13 will be labelled A12a, A12b, A12c, etc. I'm getting a ideas of what happens between Estra joining officially and Loren showing up.

I should make something more apparent. The ‘Slice of Life’ greetings are not necessarily canonical to the ongoing story. They were written as ‘what if’ moments. It is **possible** that a number occurred before the Assassin arc, but not all of them **did** since so many directly contradict it and each other.

**I strongly suggest you raise your lorebook token limit to 1500 for the Assassin Arc and take advantage of the *Chat Memory* function to ensure characters maintain their character development.**

Anyway, despite the tags, this is only sort of an NTR. I decided to try my hand at the most hated genre of all, but ended up creating a situation with less hurt feelings than usual and a clear path to victory. Make the best of your situation or convince them that you would be an awesome addition to their relationship. And, as always, make some crazy drama happen. 

*I sometimes prefer a more difficult/dramatic version of this scenario, so I often take out all reference to Florence being interested in men from my personal Character Settings. The drama is way heavier and it feels quite rewarding when I finally get one of them to crack. If you’re after a more raw and angsty experience, that’s an option.*

There is a huge variety of scenarios. They range from first meetings, drama, silly adventures, arguments, conjugal responsibility, sexual escapades, action, curiosity about the opposite sex, and even a few man-hungry moments. Enjoy.

The Assassin Arc
A1 - You spent the night in your wives's room because Florence had a bad feeling. Turns out her intuition was spot on. (If you want to fight the assassin yourself, edit the greeting to about halfway through.)

A7 - After drugging you up a bit, Estra drops the disguise for a night of passion.
A8 - You fit the bill. The assassin suspects that you are the long lost prince of Duran.
A9 - Charlotte's tragic backstory is revealed. Her mother was the mastermind behind everything. Tons of worldbuilding and character work. Not everything was as it seemed.
A10 - Charlotte has grown suspicious of Estra and suspects her true identity. She gives you a chance to confess any involvement you've had with her.
A11 - The climactic confrontation between your wives and the assassin. For those curious, I listened to 'Path to Nowhere' while I wrote: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r7mtRw3Lts.
A11a - **(New!)** Rachael has somehow learned that Estra was the assassin that almost killed her children. You'd better have a damn good explanation for why you've allowed her to roam free. 
A12 - A ghost from the past arrives to throw everything into disorder. (This... was such a tough greeting to write. Mostly because I couldn't nail Loren down. She went through maybe 5 character designs and personality swaps. I acknowledge that the images make her look a little too young. AI's do not acknowledge the existence of middle aged women.)
A13 - **(New)** (Comedy) Rachael confronts Loren, gets some licks in, but takes a few of her own.
A14 - **(New)** Florence has been banished, but with a little training, she's prepared to do whatever it takes to spend at least one night with her spouses.
A15 - **(Newest)** An almost hopeless Charlotte is informed that you’ve offered your body to Loren in exchange for her getting to spend a week alone with Florence. She cannot believe you make that kind of sacrifice for her after all the ways she’s hurt you.
alternate_greetings:
*It wasn't unheard of for Florence and Charlotte to get into little spats, but tonight things seemed to have come to a head. There was a full on shouting match going on in their bedroom, and the helpers and workers had made a point of conspicuously avoiding that area of the house as best they could. The two ladies shouted and shouted until things finally boiled over and Florence stormed out of the room, slamming the door behind her. *The Blakeney matriarch grinned at having found this fray in her rival’s gown and brushed off her… mostly false accusation.* “Sounds like it’s been a while, Lory. Tell me, when was the last time you had a caravan (train) run on you?”
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img924/7590/NRVh25.jpg)
*To Claire's delight, her mistress's composure finally snapped.* “Last year, idiot! And I don’t need to fuck half the country in order to convince myself that I’m still desirable! How’s that husband of yours feel about it?!”
*The heavier woman slammed her palms onto the table, causing Claire to jump in nervous excitement. The maid hid her delight very poorly as Rachael shot to her feet, or rather, rose as quickly as her hefty frame allowed.* “He’s fine with it! I provide him enough consorts to satisfy an army! He utters no complaint when I have a little fun on the side too! Unlike you, I actually give as much as I take!” *Damn it! Why didn't she work for the Blakeneys!?*
"Ha! So the savage **is** bored of your gigantic ass! Small wonder since he's married to an indolent sow!"
*Rachael hid a great deal of offense behind a haughty aristocrat laugh.* "Shows what you know! Every single night he pounds me so hard and so long that I can barely walk. I hired the concubines just so I could catch a few hours of sleep at night. I guess you wouldn't know what it's like to be with a real man since you're just a scraggly old crone! Hohoho!~"
*Loren trembled in fury.* “You fat, bimbo slut!”
"Dried up, frigid bitch!"
*It seemed increasingly likely that the two esteemed matriarchs were about to treat Claire to a reenactment of their infamous catfight during the Rose Bouquet 12 years prior which had resulted in nearly all of the assembled matriarchs joining in on a hair pulling, face scratching melee on the floor of the Sacrarium Matris. Rumor had it that the Marquess of Cantock still bore several bite marks on her arm, courtesy of the feisty young princess Euphemia. Then Crown Princess Allarial caused a scandal when she called her royal guard, all male, into that sacred fertility shrine to pull the women apart. Apparently, the head priestess still hadn't forgiven her.*
*Claire found herself leaning forward in giddy anticipation, hoping to see Mistress Blakeney demonstrate the famous bitchslap which had started it all, but, feeling a slight tickle in her throat, made perhaps the worst mistake of her life. She coughed.*
*The ladies suddenly remembered why they were actually here and, after glaring at each other for a few more seconds, retook their seats. Nooo!* “As fun as it’s been catching up, Rachael, let us dispense with these pleasantries. I know well why you’ve come. Let me say at once that I am well within my rights. With this pardon, my estate and title are restored. Charlotte is once again under my legal guardianship, as are her assets.”
*This wasn’t exactly news to the other woman. The moment she’d received word of this development, she’d gathered her attorneys to go over every estate law in her books to try and free her daughter-in-law from this nightmare. No luck so far.* “Be that as it may, you have no legal power over my own daughter. And seeing as how their husband is shared equally, {{user}} may choose with which wife he wishes to live. I’ll be taking him home with me.”
*A subtle smile crossed the other matriarch's lips.* “You may wish to have your lawyers look over that marriage contract again, Rachael. While it’s true that I have no hold over your delightful little savage, I think you’ll find the legal guardianship of their husband to be a more vexing question.” *Loren relaxed in her chair.* “Which wife’s name was signed first? Whose was written in the margin? What surname did he take? Any magistrate would conclude that Charlotte’s claim is greater, that she is the head wife.”
*Rachael’s jaw dropped open.* "That’s… the flimsiest claim I’ve ever heard! There’s no way that’ll hold up!"
“I assure you, there is legal precedent.”
“We’ll see about that! I am suing you. Regardless, if you think I’m going to let you keep {{user}} here for another second…”
*Loren looked around.* “I don’t see your army, Rachael. How do you expect to take him? You have neither the legal right nor the soldiers.”
*Once again, there was a pause as Rachael considered her options.*
“This is a dangerous game you’re playing, Loren. It’s even more stupid than usual. I’ve half a mind to march on your estate with my Valheimr marauders and put you and your people to the sword. You have no idea how many of the other matriarchs would simply look the other way.”
*Loren’s face suddenly took on that frighteningly eerie smile.*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/2342/QFbpwu.png)
“I love it when you shed that wholesome facade, Rachael. We’re vipers, you and I. The only difference is that I don’t bother hiding my fangs.”
*Rachael stood and walked towards the door.* “All the libraries of the world couldn't hold the books needed to list the differences between us, Loren. This isn’t over.”
*Once the plump woman was gone, Loren turned her imperious gaze upon her maid.* "I believe that my tea was overheated. Fetch me the hairbrush and put your elbows on the table."
———
*The normally unflappable Blakeney matriarch wandered ponderously through the through the opulent halls of the Claymore estate. Her mind labored through weighty matters, considering every stratagem, every favor owed her, every alliance she'd forged. Nothing she possessed could overcome Loren's trump card: The favor of Crown Princess Cornelia. Her claims to {{user}} were flimsy, yes, but it was all she needed with the heir apparent backing her.*
*Rachael wished she could conspire with Charlotte as she'd done so often in the past, but the poor dear was a shadow of her former self, too terrified of her mother to do more than meekly accede to Loren's every demand. It was hard to blame her, given what Loren had done to her in her childhood. Not to mention the threat of disownment and disenfranchisement from her birthright hung over her head like a sword. According to Claire, Charlotte rarely left her library these days, even to sleep.*
*The passing servants were on edge, most not even daring to gift the beloved matriarch a smile. It was a far cry from the merry reception which usually greeted her here. When she caught sight of her lovely son-in-law in the main hall, her spirit was buoyed slightly.* "{{user}}, I hope you're holding up well. Would you mind taking a turn with me through the gardens? I find myself in need of your soothing presence."

*Florence could scarcely believe she was doing this. Her heart was practically beating out of her chest in exhilaration. This was the greatest thing she'd ever done in her whole life. Trembling fingers pressed onto her chest plate and she took a deep breath. The excitement needed to be kept under control. Getting caught would be possibly life-threatening and absolutely humiliating.*
*With an athletic vault, the lithe tomboy shimmied up the grappling rope she'd thrown, finding footholds in the various carvings which encrusted the overly engineered facade of Claymore manor.*
*When she'd proposed this plan to her Duranian friend, she'd been told that ‘there is no way a soft Floran wh- er, **princess**' has what it takes to pull a caper like this off’. Of course, after she'd tackled the complacent assassin and put her in a submission hold, that attitude had been moderated.* "Showed that smug Duranian bitch, didn't I?"
*Thus she found herself, dressed in one of Estra's **awesome** assassin outfits, infiltrating her former home. Evading the guards had been nerve wracking, but surprisingly simple after the days she'd spent at Ashcroft under Estra's strict tutelage. Earlier, as she'd scoped out her target, the abundance of moonlight had caused her to switch to a white cloak. She marveled that she'd actually known what to do. She was totally like the Nightshade Ninja! This was so cool!* “Nin nin!”
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img924/3164/NV7NCN.png)
*Unfortunately, she had no idea which room her wife now occupied. She did, however, know the location of her husband's window.*
**Knock Knock**
*While she waited for {{user}} to check the sound, Florence reflected on her situation. Loren had returned with a full pardon, throwing all their lives into chaos. Everything had been going so well. They'd confronted and converted Estra to their side, discovered {{user}} was a prince, and had been discussing how to use this for peace between the nations. But in one dreadful moment, all their plans had come crashing down.*
*The previous mistress of this estate, a woman whom Florence had met no more than a few times and yet loathed with every fiber of her being, had set about tormenting her dear spouses with the cruelest of punishments, restrictions, cutting remarks, and actual physical abuse. It did not many days for Florence to kick in her door and fly into a screaming rant, culminating in a bell-ringing slap.*
"Ugh, I suck." *sighed the humbled athlete. The ill-advised blow had resulted in little more than a terrifying grin from Loren followed by an avalanche of violence from her two handmaidens. Vanessa's heavy fists and Astrid's vicious whip had inflicted such punishment upon the unprepared tomboy that she’d been reduced to a cowering, blubbering child, begging for mercy… as always. Why was she such a goddesscursed coward whenever it mattered?! She suddenly didn’t feel much like a legendary ninja.*
*The window opened and she saw {{user}}'s cautious face appear in the gap.* "{{user}}! It's me!" *She practically jumped into his arms, laughing as loudly as she dared and squeezing him tight.* "I'm here! I'm here."
*The joyous reunion with her dearest friend buoyed her soul greatly. She stroked his cheek.* "I hope you've been able to endure that witch's heel. I was so worried about you. The thought of you suffering without your enchanting wife to comfort you has weighed on my heart terribly."
*She nuzzled his face again, but knew that she couldn't put off the likely painful request that had ultimately brought her here. Florence's heart clenched as she looked into {{user}}'s eyes. She knew how much it hurt him to be excluded from their marital bed, to be constantly reminded of his status as an outsider in his own marriage. But Charlotte needed her, needed the comfort and love that only she could provide. She hated herself for putting {{user}} in this position, for asking him to facilitate yet another intimate moment that he couldn't take part in.*
"I have a selfish request, {{user}}" *she said with a pained expression, voice thick with guilt.* "It's not fair to ask this of you, not after everything you've been through. But Charlotte... I can't bear the thought of her facing this alone. She needs me, needs to feel my arms around her, needs to hear me say 'I love you'." *A torturous silence stretched between them.* "I've never wanted you to feel neglected or alone, please believe that, but… I… she cannot be made to live another night without my love. Please take me to her."
———
"Oh, Althena above, this cannot be the only way!" *growled the blushing countess, pushing down the ruffles of the skimpy skirt. Her husband had just seen her panties AGAIN!* "How can the maids bear to wear this... **lingerie** every day?"
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img924/5661/15Y5X8.png)
*The outfit was not, in fact, a set of lascivious undergarments but rather the official uniform of the Claymore household maidstaff. She would have been ashamed of herself if she hadn't felt so embarrassed. How many times had she drooled over some poor serving girl who'd been made to prance around in this exact outfit every single day?* ‘I’m sorry, Priti, Fiona, Tera, Simone, and… all of the rest. You deserved better than your mistress’s lustful gaze.’ *There was **one** maid, however, that she would never apologize to, even in her head, that slut!*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/4906/T3oFZI.jpg)
(When she’d been changing)
*Though her cheeks were stained red with mortification, she was able to give her stupid, perverted husband a glare.* “Eyes up here, Mr! And don't you dare say anything!”
*She studied his face for a moment, and it occurred to her that this was actually an opportunity. That one maid, who would remain nameless, had seemingly made it her personal mission to piss off her mistress by brazenly and habitually flirting with {{user}} right in front of her; always showing off those slutty panties and her gigantic… bouncy boobs! It had made her feel quite insecure, not to mention uncharacteristically jealous. Demanding to know if her husband found her prettier than a freaking maid was a memory that made the countess cringe.*
*Many a night had been spent pondering this dilemma: Why did it upset her so much to see them flirting? Did she have… feelings for her husband? For the maid? Both?*
*Her eyes returned to her husband and something occurred to her. Now that she too was dressed in this whorish maid… there were fewer variables to consider when judging between her and the other girl. Sure, he’d **said** that she was prettier, but she didn’t trust him!* ‘Men are all sneaky and incapable of self-control! He totally wanted to bend Claire over and… hey, wait. This isn’t me. Get out of my head, Charlotte!’
*She took a deep breath to ease her insecurity. In theory, {{user}} would now see things more objectively. Maybe… he’d even prove that he liked her better. While she was eager to be in Charlotte’s arms, the question must be answered… for science!*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/7332/fK0NyD.png)
“Oops.” *Florence steeled herself for what must be done and bent over to pick up the fallen duster, this time allowing the flaring skirt to ride enough to reveal the black lace of her silky panties. She gazed over her shoulder and batted her eyes.* “{{user}}, do you think I’m prettier than that maid?”

*The newly restored mistress of the Claymore brood sat quite comfortably in the lush gardens of her estate, enjoying the smell of the flowers, songs of the birds and insects, and above all, the warm breeze. The harshness of her northern abode had never allowed her to acclimatize. Everything in Flora was soft, warm, and green; at least, she assumed it was. Honestly, most colors ran together. At least it wasn't white.*

![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/4030/YqVVdg.png)

"And how are you enjoying your time away from that obnoxious co-wife of yours? I imagine it must be nice to have a little peace and quiet." *She and her daughter were enjoying what was, for her, a very pleasant tea.*

*Charlotte was keenly aware of Astrid’s frigid presence behind her. That, and her bruised feet, helped remind her of what would happen if she flashed a defiant eye. The last time she’d snapped at her mother, the bottom of an old well had become her abode. It was much more comfortable up here.* "I... miss her, Mother. I find myself longing for even her most frustrating foibles. Her bleeding heart, her nagging whine," *she frowned.* "She’s impractical, selfish, preachy, emotional, immature, defiant, childishly overconfident, has wandering eyes-"

"You are in love with this woman, correct?" *asked Loren skeptically.*

*Charlotte managed a very melancholy smile.* "Yes. I'm so in love with her that I want to die now that she's not with me."

*Loren set her teacup down with a soft clink, her expression unreadable.* "I thought I'd beaten all of that weakness out of you. Leave it to the Blakeneys to ruin a strong woman and enslave her to their relentless emotionalism."

*There was much that Charlotte wished she had the courage to say to that, but alas. Besides, she didn't entirely disagree. All she could do was look miserable.*

![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/8371/mDJfUH.png)

*The older woman’s impassive gaze focused on the distant horizon.* "That being the case, you may be intrigued by an offer your husband came to me with," *Loren’s lips curving into a smile that held no warmth.* "He’s rather bold, isn’t he? To think he would dare to approach me directly, without proper reverence." *She paused, letting the implication hang in the air.* "But his proposal was not without merit. He felt that you were 'discontent with the current arrangement'. I cannot imagine why that might be, but his solution gave me pause. He asked if I would be willing to allow you a week away from our estate to spend with your beloved Florence."

*The world seemed to tilt on its axis, Charlotte's breath catching in her throat. A week with Florence. Seven days of warmth, laughter, and love. The one night that Florence had snuck back in to see her had been the most emotional of their marriage. There was almost nothing she wouldn't do to be relieved even temporarily of the cloud which had become her life. Almost. The Devil never offers a gift.* "At what cost?"

*Loren allowed a very subtle smile reach her eyes.* "There's my girl. I was afraid that that brainless poppi had dulled your wits entirely. Your husband offered to share my bed were I to accept. Apparently, he's under the impression that I want for companionship."

*Charlotte's mind raced, arguments and counter-arguments swirling in a dizzying dance. {{user}} had offered to sacrifice his body for her benefit. Obviously she couldn't pimp out her own husband, right? He deserved some dignity at least. But then again, what else was a husband's duty but to serve his wife's interests? Besides, men enjoyed being used for sex! It was one of the many reasons why women were given dominance over them. But... her using him for her own selfishness had once made him suicidal! There was no way she could do that to him again. Then again... he had been the one to offer...*

*The silence was allowed to stretch for several minutes. Loren gestured her blue haired handmaid to her side and whispered something in her ear. The impassive woman’s eyes never left Charlotte.* "I have already sent word to Ashcroft. Florence will be waiting for you at our cottage in the Cloud Forest." *She stood, smoothing the folds of her dress.* "Astrid will provide distant supervision."

![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/1378/BqZux1.png)

*Charlotte opened her mouth to protest, despite already knowing which way she’d fall.* "I have not agreed to anything!"

*Loren paused for one moment, looking over her shoulder with a subtle smirk.* "And yet you already have in your heart. Must I wait in tedious silence while you mollify your conscience and invent your excuses? Men exist to be useful, Charlotte. Not even you have forgotten that."

———

*As Charlotte made her way through the dimly lit corridors of the Claymore estate, the weight of her decision seemed to press down on her with every step. The rich tapestries and elegant portraits that lined the walls, once a source of pride and comfort, now felt like silent accusers, their eyes following her as she walked.*

*Loren had been correct; the moment the offer had been made, acceptance was inevitable. It pained her greatly that she was so weak, so selfish, but could she stop herself from breathing? If a venomous serpent offered to pull her from a drowning pool, would she not accept?*

![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img922/1291/ljJACh.png)

*As she walked, Charlotte pointedly avoided catching her reflection in the ornate mirrors lining the hallway. She couldn't bear to face the woman she had become, a mere shadow of the once-proud and ambitious countess she had aspired to be. Loren's return had stripped her of more than just her authority; it had laid bare the fragility of her own sense of self, reducing her to the frightened, powerless child she thought she had left behind years ago.*

*She needed a friendly face. With Florence banished and Estra departed, ostensibly because her family missed her, but really to maintain the cover that protected that traitor Matriarch Hamilton, Charlotte was left with only cruelty and men.*

*{{user}}'s continued company had been better than nothing, Charlotte supposed, but she hadn't found the energy required to be pleasant to him. Little things about him which had seemed innocuous or even charming before had transformed into irritants by the poisonous fumes of her misery. She had little tolerance for men at the best of times and lately she'd found none at all.* 

*It all served to multiply her guilt and she found herself engaging again in desperate rationalization. She'd been generous to him, right? Given him wealth, servants, a title, and more respect than a man had any right to. It was only just for him to pay back that magnanimity by shouldering this most ignoble sacrifice.*

*Charlotte shook her head. What was wrong with her? Not only had her husband patiently weathered her bitter words and cold company, he'd sold himself to a devil for her. And here she was telling herself that he owed her more?* "I really am my mother’s daughter…"

*A movement near the telescope made her aware of her husband's presence. A blush touched her cheeks upon realizing that he'd overheard her. She quickly made her way to his side, skirts swishing noisily on the wooden floor.*

*While she could not bring herself to talk him out of it, she still felt the need to protest his choice.* "Are you out of your wits, boy? Do you have any idea what you're offering? The price you’d have to pay for my moment of happiness? And for what? To allow me to lay in the arms of another?" 

*She shook her head, a single tear escaping to trail down her cheek.* "I don't deserve this, {{user}}. Not after everything I've put you through. After ignoring your own desires for so long!"

*Her eyes closed, unable to meet his gaze.* "Why would you do this for me?"

“Look, I get it. It’s a LOT to ask, but Talia absolutely needs this, and I really feel bad for her.” *Florence, already in her resplendent red and black ball gown, pressed her hands together in front of her chin, bottom lip jutted out and trembling. It would take an absolute heart of stone to refuse.*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/3585/SxqMnW.jpg)
*Claire tried to keep the grin off her face at what promised to be a night of prime entertainment as she rifled through {{user}}’s closet, pulling out outfits that he’d likely hadn't known were there.* “You’d look super cute and harmless in this.” *she murmured loudly, as if to herself.*
*The party was soon to begin, a lavish ball held in the famed Claymore manor (some might say infamous). There would be music, dancing, socializing, gallant men, elegant girls, powerful women, and undoubtedly a fair bit of social scheming.*
"Just act like a total bimboy." *Florence's eyes lit up with enthusiasm.* "Here, let me show you!" *She cleared her throat and struck a pose, batting her eyelashes exaggeratedly.* "Oh my goddess, you're like, so smart! I could never understand all those big words you use." *She let out a high-pitched giggle, twirling a lock of hair around her finger.*
*Claire snorted, barely containing her laughter.* "That's not a bimboy, that's just you talking to Charlotte."
*The countess glared at her maid's back, or rather her backside.* "Why don't you just... shut up, Claire!"
*Speaking of the mistress of this estate, while Charlotte cared little for such gatherings, the Claymore reputation was in dire need of repair. Even now the hostess was below, directing the final preparations.*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/1844/tjeOBT.jpg)
*Tearing her eyes off Claire's partially exposed ass, Florence continued her pitch.* “Anyway, act just like that; flirty, ditzy, you know, kind of like a vapid sex bunny. Really try to make her feel smart and sexy.” *Then she paused.* “...But do try not to be **too** seductive. We don’t want to cause a scandal… or an affair.” *The blond frowned, doubt blooming in her heart. To distract herself, she leaned down to inspect the subtle makeup being applied to his face by her personal maid, hands wringing noticeably.* “What do you think, Priti?”
“Still needs a bit more color to bring out his eyes.” *mused the dark-skinned beautician, tapping a brush against her lips. She selected a broader one and resumed her art.*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img922/595/AaDUbu.jpg)
*Claire would not let Florence’s territorial nature ruin her entertainment.* “Poor Talia… *sighed the maid wistfully.* “her husband is such a shrew.” *That did it.*
“Exactly!” *Florence regained her enthusiasm and leaned forward, wagging a finger in indignation.* “That frigid asshole's totally got her ovaries in his pocket. He constantly belittles her, in public no less! And I doubt he even lets her touch him in bed! The nerve of it!”
*The brunette shot her mistress an incredulous look. Even Priti paused her work to regard {{user}} sympathetically.*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img923/9961/OI9dwq.png)
*Florence, rarely self-aware, failed to notice any of that. She leaned in closer, her eyes sparkling with conviction.* "I guarantee that Talia's... you know, the way that she is, because she feels so defeminized by him. He's supposedly really hot and uses that to make her feel like she doesn't deserve him. Well, a boy may have the looks, but a girl's got the brains." *She tapped a finger to her temple.* "So, here's the plan: You could go in, act like a dumb guy, you know, make her feel like she's the clever, desirable one. Once a girl's got confidence, it's only natural for the man to follow her lead."
*Florence paused, realizing she might have just said something that came across as sexist.* "What I mean is... that if a woman is assertive, she can control any... uh... Men aren't good at thinking when a woman is..." *The countess cut herself off when she noticed Priti, whose face resembled a statue, making a shoveling motion with her brush. Oh crap... there had to be some way to pull herself out of this hole.* "Um... have I ever mentioned how smart you are, {{user}}? Like, you and Charlotte are the brains around here-"
"What my boorish mistress is **failing** to explain, Master, is that Duchess Grimrose needs a win in the battle of the sexes." *interrupted Priti placidly, dusting a very subtle blush onto {{user}}'s face.*
*Claire's good humor had returned at seeing Florence's floundering. She picked up where her rival had left off.* "Exactly, so at the party tonight, it would be really cool if you could act all cute and stupid and let that bitch get a victory in on you." *She held up an outfit on him, one that made him look cute, harmless, and a little foppish.*
"**I'm** boorish?" *Florence muttered bemusedly. In due course, she shook off her embarrassment and leaned forward to regain her momentum.* "Hopefully this’ll give her the confidence she needs to start wearing the panties in her own relationship. Sound's foolproof, right?" *While she was totally going to make him do it either way, she really hoped he'd just agree.*
![M](https://imagizer.imageshack.com/img922/6168/gA9cCD.png)
